channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Brent oil jumps more than 4% as U.S. reportedly sends third aircraft carrier to Middle East
item.description: Oil prices rose sharply Thursday following a report the U.S. is sending a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East.

item.title: Nike is set to report earnings after the bell. Here's what to expect
item.description: Nike is expected to post another quarter of declining sales as the company tries to turn around its business and regain growth in China.

item.title: Trump could target three Fed governors. Removing them may be harder than it looks
item.description: Trump could seek to remove Jerome Powell, Lisa Cook and Michael Barr from the Federal Reserve, but court rulings and lengthy litigation could limit him.

item.title: Stocks rise in choppy first October session as Treasury yields ease from multidecade highs: Live updates
item.description: Stocks seesawed Thursday, with traders closely watching neck-breaking moves in Treasury yields, while a blockbuster earnings report failed to boost Micron shares.

item.title: Boeing engineers and technical workers approve new contract, avoiding strike
item.description: The work group comprises Boeing's largest white-collar union.

item.title: Trump Accounts have auto-enrolled more than 60 million children, Treasury says
item.description: More than 60 million children have been automatically enrolled in Trump Accounts, according to a Treasury Department announcement exclusively provided to CNBC.

item.title: Generate more portfolio income in volatile times with these options strategies
item.description: When times get rocky, options strategies can boost your portfolio's income — if they're done right.

item.title: The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect
item.description: Wall Street is looking for job growth of 84,000 to close out the summer.

item.title: Mattel shares rise after reports of takeover interest from Authentic Brands Group
item.description: Shares of toymaker Mattel rose Thursday after the Wall Street Journal reported that Authentic Brands Group had expressed interest in buying the toy maker.

item.title: New York City's 'click to cancel' subscription rule takes effect, joining states with similar laws
item.description: The Big Apple joins a growing number of jurisdictions adopting 'click to cancel' rules as the future of a federal standard remains unsettled.

item.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans AI 'robo bosses' in landmark state law, reversing his earlier veto
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has banned 'robo-bosses' from firing workers, the first U.S. state with such a law.

item.description: Follow CNBC AI Forum 2026 live updates from Dallas on enterprise AI, agents, security, costs, governance and the global technology race.

item.title: General Motor Q3 sales drop 5.5%, while Toyota buoyed by EVs, hybrids
item.description: GM's sales of all-electric vehicles are down across the board, as enthusiasm for electric vehicles wanes.

item.title: United Airlines gets aggressive in battle for top Delta, American flyers
item.description: United Airlines launched an aggressive status match program for Delta and American's top frequent flyer elites.

item.title: Judge dismisses Reflecting Pool case permanently, cites risk Trump will force new charges

item.title: Former LinkedIn chief Roslansky to leave Microsoft, following other exec departures
item.description: Gaming head Phil Spencer and Office leader Rajesh Jha both left this year, and Charlie Bell, the company's head of security, became an individual contributor.

item.title: Jim Cramer sees a huge catalyst on the horizon for Apple. How to play the stock
item.description: The iPhone Duo is what will drive Apple's next leg higher, Jim Cramer predicted.

item.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is 'still too high' even after softer-than-expected PCE data, labor market is 'pretty good'

item.title: Billionaire family offices bet on geothermal energy, brain implants in September
